title: Gas
description: Natural gas from PG&E's daily meter readings.

target.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', m.date, 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time,
       m.label AS text
FROM core_milestone m
WHERE m.date >= date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '-1 day')
  AND m.date <= date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')
ORDER BY m.date

panels.title: Gas used
panels.description: Therms over the selected range, from PG&E's daily readings.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT SUM(s.value) / 29307.1 AS v
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug = 'pge_gas' AND se.metric = 'gas_wh'
  AND s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')

panels.title: Summer baseline
panels.description: Average therms per day over the latest June–August on record — what the house burns with no heating (water, cooking). Ignores the time picker.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT SUM(s.value) / 29307.1 / COUNT(*) AS v
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug = 'pge_gas' AND se.metric = 'gas_wh'
  AND CAST(strftime('%m', s.ts, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6 AND 8
  AND strftime('%Y', s.ts, 'localtime') = (
    SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', s.ts, 'localtime')) FROM core_sample s JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id WHERE so.slug = 'pge_gas' AND se.metric = 'gas_wh'
      AND CAST(strftime('%m', s.ts, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) = 8)

panels.title: Data through
panels.description: Last day PG&E has reported. The pge_gas collector checks every 6 hours; PG&E posts a day 1–2 days late. Much older than that means the collector needs `manage.py pge_auth` (see /health/).

targets.rawQueryText:

FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug = 'pge_gas' AND se.metric = 'gas_wh'

panels.title: Gas use over the range
panels.description: Therms per day for ranges up to a month, per week (Monday start) up to 6 months, per month beyond that. The meter counts in whole units of about one therm, so day by day a quiet stretch reads 0, 0, 0, 1 rather than a steady trickle — weeks smooth that out. Days PG&E didn't report are left blank, not zero.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN $__to - $__from <= 31 * 86400000
            THEN CAST(strftime('%s', datetime(s.ts, 'localtime', 'start of day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER)
            WHEN $__to - $__from <= 183 * 86400000
            THEN CAST(strftime('%s', datetime(s.ts, 'localtime', 'start of day', 'weekday 0', '-6 days'), 'utc') AS INTEGER)
            ELSE CAST(strftime('%s', datetime(s.ts, 'localtime', 'start of month'), 'utc') AS INTEGER)
       END AS time,
       SUM(s.value) / 29307.1 AS "Gas"
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug = 'pge_gas' AND se.metric = 'gas_wh'
  AND s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gas by month — year over year
panels.description: Therms in each calendar month, one bar per year, every year on record. This year in full colour, last year lighter, earlier years grey. The first month and the current month are partial, and a month with unreported days reads low. Ignores the time picker.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', s.ts, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) AS m,
         strftime('%Y', s.ts, 'localtime') AS year,
         SUM(s.value) / 29307.1 AS therms
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE so.slug = 'pge_gas' AND se.metric = 'gas_wh'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), months(m) AS (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT m + 1 FROM months WHERE m < 12
)
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (months.m - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) AS month,
       -- Named relative to today so the two recent years can be coloured.
       y.year || CASE CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) - CAST(y.year AS INTEGER)
                   WHEN 0 THEN ' (this year)' WHEN 1 THEN ' (last year)' ELSE '' END AS year,
       agg.therms AS therms
FROM months
CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM agg) y
LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.m = months.m AND agg.year = y.year
ORDER BY months.m, y.year
